test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to census 2011, percentage of Urban population in India is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 31.16.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Point__**

__
 
• **The correct answer is Option 3, i.e., 31.16%.**
 
• The Census of India is conducted every ten years to gather** demographic and socio-economic data on the country's population.**
 
• **The 2011 Census of India reported that the total population of India was 1.21 billion**, out of which 377 million people lived in urban areas.
 
• The percentage of the urban population in India has been increasing over the years. In 2001, it was 27.8%, and in 2011, it rose to 31.16%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Urbanization refers to the process of population shifting from rural to urban areas, leading to the growth of cities and towns.
 
• ** 25.6%**, represents the percentage of the rural population in India as per Census 2011.
 
• ** 21.6%,** is not related to the urban population of India. It could be a percentage related to any other demographic or socio-economic aspect of the country.
 
• **35.6%,** is also not related to the urban population of India. It could be a percentage related to any other demographic or socio-economic aspect of the country.
